grades.reason: The passage is a code sketch of xv6's sleep/wakeup. It shows how overlapping locks (pipe->lock held until p->lock is acquired and p->state is SLEEPING) avoid a lost wake-up. A lost wake-up is the likely cause when the condition changes and wakeup runs but the sleeper never wakes. It gives the mechanism and fix only in compressed form, without explaining the failure or how to diagnose it.
